text: Seyɗaane seeraani e soklinde ɓe ŋarɗina, haa o liɓi ɓe e goopol, ɓe ñaami e kiin lekki ki ɓe kaɗanoo, njoɓdi maɓɓe wonndoo ko Alla yaltini ɓe aljanna, Alla wii ɓe kamɓe e seyɗaane o: njippoɗee dow lesdi, ngonon añondirɓe, tabiton toon mbeltoron e moƴƴi gonɗi heen haa kala nde happu mon yonti, darnga daroo.
